_note: HOT CAR ANALYZER config file - edit and save, then run the program again.

columns._note: Column mapping: time_column=time column, fresh_air_column=fresh air temp column, return_air_column=return air temp column. Values can be a column index (0-based, 0=first column) or a column name (e.g. "Tem").

csv._note: CSV reading: skip_rows=header rows to skip; encoding=file encoding (auto / utf-8 / gbk).

alarms._note: The two threshold lines: target_temp=target temperature line (green, was 23), trigger_temp=trigger temperature line (red, was 28.5).

sensor_ranges._note: Reasonable temperature ranges used to filter out sensor errors.

analysis._note: downsample_every=sample every N rows; max_interval_minutes=max point interval in minutes (currently 20; set back to 30 for every half hour).

_output_note: output_dir: output directory; leave "" to save next to the data file.
